description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions and configurations for a device based on the imx7d-pico-pi board. It sources an external script for hardware-specific functions and defines functions to check images, perform upgrades, copy configurations, and handle pre-upgrade steps, primarily for the 'technexion,imx7d-pico-pi' board.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata check if the board matches 'technexion,imx7d-pico-pi'.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the image is supported on the current board.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process specific to the board type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files during upgrade for the specific board.
